# Card

The default surface for a task, board card or settings group: white, hairline border, 12px radius and one low shadow.

`AgentFabricDS.Card` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<AgentFabricDS.Card title={…}>…</AgentFabricDS.Card>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AgentFabricDS.Card" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

A white hairline card on the page. Elevation comes from one low shadow, not a heavy drop shadow.
